result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-leg intersection with significant crossing distances and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or refuge islands. The expansive asphalt and wide turning radii prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety, creating a hostile environment for those on foot.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The extreme width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No visible painted crosswalks exist to designate pedestrian right-of-way or increase driver awareness at this large intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and improve visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and a curb ramp with tactile warnings, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide corner radius and lack of signalization or traffic calming measures may lead to higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The rounded curb at the intersection allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner where the sidewalk meets the side street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and improve pedestrian visibility.
